product_overview: The Security module provides the platform’s internal SSO, JWT-based authentication, and centralized RBAC for users, roles, modules, pages, and permissions. It also supports password recovery, account activation, and authenticated lookup/dashboard endpoints used across the ERP platform.
core_goals: Enable secure internal login with stateless JWT access and refresh token rotation
Allow self-service password recovery and new account activation
Provide user, role, module, page, and permission administration for RBAC
Enforce two-tier authorization where roles first gain modules and then screen permissions within granted modules
Expose authenticated lookup and dashboard APIs for cross-module consumption
Support platform-wide security-related CRUD and soft-deactivation workflows

features.name: Authentication (SECURITY module)
features.description: Handles login, refresh token rotation, logout, password recovery, and account activation for internal users.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/security/auth/login with valid username and password -> Receive 200 with accessToken, refreshToken, and expiresIn -> Use returned accessToken on protected endpoints -> Receive 200 responses from authenticated APIs
POST /api/v1/security/auth/login with missing username or password -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/v1/security/auth/login with invalid credentials or inactive account -> Receive 401 unauthorized

POST /api/v1/security/auth/refresh with a valid refreshToken -> Receive 200 with a new accessToken, new refreshToken, and expiresIn -> Use the rotated refreshToken on future refresh calls -> Receive 200 for continued session
POST /api/v1/security/auth/refresh with missing refreshToken -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/v1/security/auth/refresh with expired, invalid, or already-rotated refreshToken -> Receive 401 unauthorized
POST /api/v1/security/auth/logout with valid bearer token and refreshToken -> Receive 204 no content and revoke the refresh token
POST /api/v1/security/auth/logout without a valid bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized
POST /api/v1/security/auth/forgot-password with a valid email address -> Receive 202 accepted regardless of whether the email exists
POST /api/v1/security/auth/forgot-password with malformed email -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/v1/security/auth/reset-password with valid reset token and strong newPassword -> Receive 200 status envelope and password updated
POST /api/v1/security/auth/reset-password with expired or invalid token -> Receive 400 invalid token error
POST /api/v1/security/auth/activate with valid activation token and newPassword -> Receive 200 status envelope and account activated
POST /api/v1/security/auth/activate with expired or invalid token -> Receive 400 invalid token error

features.name: Current User Dashboard (SECURITY module)

user_flows: GET /api/v1/security/me/modules with a valid bearer token -> Receive 200 with an array of granted active modules for the current user
GET /api/v1/security/me/modules without a bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized
GET /api/v1/security/me/modules with a malformed or expired bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.name: User Management (SECURITY module)
features.description: Manages security user accounts, including creation, search, updates, soft deactivation, and role assignment.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/security/users with valid user data and a bearer token holding PERM_SEC_USERS_CREATE -> Receive 201 with the created UserResponse
POST /api/v1/security/users with a duplicate username or email -> Receive 409 conflict
POST /api/v1/security/users with missing required fields -> Receive 400 validation error
GET /api/v1/security/users with query filters and a bearer token holding PERM_SEC_USERS_VIEW -> Receive 200 with a paged user list
GET /api/v1/security/users without a bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized
GET /api/v1/security/users with a bearer token lacking PERM_SEC_USERS_VIEW -> Receive 403 forbidden
PUT /api/v1/security/users/{id} with valid editable fields and PERM_SEC_USERS_UPDATE -> Receive 200 with the updated UserResponse
PUT /api/v1/security/users/{id} for a non-existent user -> Receive 404 not found
DELETE /api/v1/security/users/{id} with PERM_SEC_USERS_DELETE -> Receive 204 no content and the user is soft-deactivated
DELETE /api/v1/security/users/{id} for a non-existent user -> Receive 404 not found
POST /api/v1/security/users/{id}/roles with a valid roleId and PERM_SEC_USERS_UPDATE -> Receive 200 status envelope and role assigned
POST /api/v1/security/users/{id}/roles with a role already assigned -> Receive 409 conflict
GET /api/v1/security/users/{id}/roles with PERM_SEC_USERS_VIEW -> Receive 200 with the user’s assigned roles
GET /api/v1/security/users/{id}/roles without authorization -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.description: Provides CRUD for roles plus Tier-1 module grants and Tier-2 permission grants/revokes.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/security/roles with valid role data and PERM_SEC_ROLES_CREATE -> Receive 201 with the created role
POST /api/v1/security/roles with duplicate roleCode -> Receive 409 conflict
POST /api/v1/security/roles/search with filters and PERM_SEC_ROLES_VIEW -> Receive 200 with a paged role list
GET /api/v1/security/roles/{id} with PERM_SEC_ROLES_VIEW -> Receive 200 with the role details
PUT /api/v1/security/roles/{id} with valid updates and PERM_SEC_ROLES_UPDATE -> Receive 200 with the updated role
DELETE /api/v1/security/roles/{id} with PERM_SEC_ROLES_DELETE -> Receive 204 no content and the role is soft-deactivated
POST /api/v1/security/roles/{id}/modules with a valid moduleId and PERM_SEC_ROLES_UPDATE -> Receive 200 status envelope and module assigned to the role
POST /api/v1/security/roles/{id}/modules with a module already granted -> Receive 409 conflict with ERR-0013 business status
DELETE /api/v1/security/roles/{id}/modules/{moduleId} with PERM_SEC_ROLES_UPDATE -> Receive 200 status envelope and the module grant is revoked
GET /api/v1/security/roles/{id}/modules with PERM_SEC_ROLES_VIEW -> Receive 200 with the role’s granted modules
POST /api/v1/security/roles/{id}/permissions with a valid permissionId and PERM_SEC_ROLES_UPDATE -> Receive 200 status envelope and permission granted
POST /api/v1/security/roles/{id}/permissions with a permission already granted -> Receive 409 conflict with ERR-0014 business status
DELETE /api/v1/security/roles/{id}/permissions/{permissionId} with PERM_SEC_ROLES_UPDATE -> Receive 200 status envelope and permission revoked
GET /api/v1/security/roles/{id}/permissions with PERM_SEC_ROLES_VIEW -> Receive 200 with the role’s granted permissions

POST /api/v1/files with a missing file or invalid category constraints -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/v1/files/{id}/access-token with PERM_FILE_BROWSER_VIEW -> Receive 200 with a short-lived download accessToken and expiresAt

features.name: MDM Lookup Consumption (MASTERDATA module)

GET /api/v1/mdm/lookups/{typeCode} without a bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized

GET /api/v1/notifications/logs/{id} for a non-existent log entry -> Receive 404 not found

GET /api/v1/notifications/lookups/{lookupKey} without a bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized
GET /api/v1/notifications/lookups/{lookupKey} with an unknown lookupKey -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: Authentication (SECURITY module)
features.description: Login, JWT access/refresh token issuance and rotation, logout, and self-service password recovery / account activation. All endpoints are pre-auth/public except logout.

endpoints.description: Authenticate with username/password and issue an access + refresh token pair.

response_schema.200: { accessToken: string, refreshToken: string, expiresIn: long }
response_schema.401: invalid credentials / account locked or inactive

endpoints.description: Rotate a refresh token for a new access/refresh token pair.

response_schema.200: { accessToken: string, refreshToken: string, expiresIn: long }

endpoints.description: Revoke a refresh token (idempotent). Requires an authenticated caller (NOT on the public allow-list).

response_schema.204: no content (logout succeeded or token already invalid — idempotent)

endpoints.description: Request a password-reset token by email. Always returns a neutral 202 to avoid account enumeration.

response_schema.202: accepted regardless of whether the email exists (neutral response)

endpoints.description: Reset the password using a previously issued reset token.
Activate a new account using an activation token, setting the initial password.

features.name: Current User Dashboard (SECURITY module)
features.description: Self-scoped endpoint returning the authenticated caller's own granted, active dashboard modules (resolved from the JWT principal, no explicit authority check).

endpoints.description: List the current authenticated user's granted, active dashboard modules.

response_schema.200: array of { id, moduleCode, nameAr, nameEn, isActiveFl, createdAt, createdBy, updatedAt, updatedBy }

features.name: User Management (SECURITY module)
features.description: CRUD for security user accounts, soft deactivation, and role assignment (RBAC). Search is GET with query-param filters (deliberate deviation from POST /search).

endpoints.description: Create a new user account. Requires PERM_SEC_USERS_CREATE authority.

response_schema.201: { id, username, email, phone, fullName, preferredLangId, userStatusId, failedLoginCount, lockedUntil, isActiveFl, createdAt, createdBy, updatedAt, updatedBy }

endpoints.description: Search/list users with query-param filters (username, email, userStatusId, isActiveFl, paging/sorting). Requires PERM_SEC_USERS_VIEW.
Update a user's mutable fields (email/phone/fullName/preferredLangId/userStatusId/isActiveFl). Requires PERM_SEC_USERS_UPDATE.
Soft-deactivate a user (isActiveFl=false, userStatusId=INACTIVE). Requires PERM_SEC_USERS_DELETE.
Assign a role to a user. Requires PERM_SEC_USERS_UPDATE.
List a user's assigned roles. Requires PERM_SEC_USERS_VIEW.

List a role's granted (Tier-1) modules. Requires PERM_SEC_ROLES_VIEW.

Revoke a permission grant from a role. Requires PERM_SEC_ROLES_UPDATE.
List a role's granted (Tier-2) permissions. Requires PERM_SEC_ROLES_VIEW.

features.name: MDM Lookup Management (MASTERDATA module)
features.description: Master-data reference lookup type and lookup value CRUD (two-level hierarchy) with soft deactivation, plus type-scoped value search.

endpoints.description: Create a lookup type. Requires PERM_MDM_LOOKUP_CREATE.

response_schema.201: { id, typeCode, nameAr, nameEn, isActiveFl, notes, createdAt, createdBy, updatedAt, updatedBy }

endpoints.description: Search lookup types. Requires PERM_MDM_LOOKUP_VIEW.
Update a lookup type. Requires PERM_MDM_LOOKUP_UPDATE.
Get a lookup type by ID. Requires PERM_MDM_LOOKUP_VIEW.
Soft-deactivate a lookup type (RULE-MDM-006 checked first, e.g. no active child values). Requires PERM_MDM_LOOKUP_DELETE.
Create a lookup value under a type. Requires PERM_MDM_LOOKUP_CREATE.

response_schema.201: { id, lookupTypeFk, valueCode, nameAr, nameEn, sortOrder, isActiveFl, notes, createdAt, createdBy, updatedAt, updatedBy }

endpoints.description: Search lookup values within a type. Requires PERM_MDM_LOOKUP_VIEW.
Update a lookup value. Requires PERM_MDM_LOOKUP_UPDATE.
Get a lookup value by ID. Requires PERM_MDM_LOOKUP_VIEW.
Soft-deactivate a lookup value (leaf entity, no child/usage check). Requires PERM_MDM_LOOKUP_DELETE.

features.name: MDM Lookup Consumption (MASTERDATA module)
features.description: Platform-wide read-only provider of active lookup values under an active type, keyed by type's natural code. Any authenticated caller may read; not gated by SCR-MDM-001 permissions.

endpoints.description: Get active lookup values for an active type by its natural type code.

response_schema.200: array of { valueCode, nameAr, nameEn, sortOrder }

features.name: Notification Dispatch (NOTIFICATION module)
features.description: Fan-out dispatch of a notification (by template code) to a recipient across one or more channels, creating NOTIF_LOG entries per channel.

endpoints.description: Dispatch a notification to a recipient via a template, fanning out across requested channels. Any authenticated caller may dispatch.

response_schema.200: { logIds: array of long } — note: plan specifies HTTP 202 but implementation returns 200 (documented api_doc_gap)
response_schema.400: validation error (missing recipientId/templateCode, blank channelHint entries)

features.name: Notification Channels (NOTIFICATION module)
features.description: CRUD and enable/disable lifecycle for notification channel configurations (e.g. email/SMS provider config).

endpoints.description: Create a notification channel config. Requires PERM_NOTIF_CHANNELS_CREATE.

response_schema.201: { id, channelTypeId, isEnabledFl, configJson, createdAt, createdBy, updatedAt, updatedBy }

endpoints.description: Search notification channel configs. Requires PERM_NOTIF_CHANNELS_VIEW.
Get a channel config by ID. Requires PERM_NOTIF_CHANNELS_VIEW.
Update a channel config. Requires PERM_NOTIF_CHANNELS_UPDATE.
Soft-disable a channel config (isEnabledFl=false, not isActiveFl). Requires PERM_NOTIF_CHANNELS_DELETE.

features.name: Notification Templates (NOTIFICATION module)
features.description: CRUD for bilingual notification templates (subject/body in AR/EN, optional attachment).

endpoints.description: Create a notification template. Requires PERM_NOTIF_TEMPLATES_CREATE.

response_schema.201: { id, templateCode, nameAr, nameEn, subjectAr, subjectEn, bodyAr, bodyEn, attachmentFileId, isActiveFl, createdAt, createdBy, updatedAt, updatedBy }

endpoints.description: Search notification templates. Requires PERM_NOTIF_TEMPLATES_VIEW.
Get a template by ID. Requires PERM_NOTIF_TEMPLATES_VIEW.
Update a template. Requires PERM_NOTIF_TEMPLATES_UPDATE.
Soft-deactivate a template. Requires PERM_NOTIF_TEMPLATES_DELETE.

features.name: Notification Logs (NOTIFICATION module)
features.description: Read-only query of the notification dispatch log (system-generated records, no create/update/delete).

endpoints.description: Search notification logs. Requires PERM_NOTIF_LOG_VIEW.

response_schema.200: paged array of { id, recipientId, channelTypeId, notificationStatusId, moduleCode, referenceId, referenceType, retryCount, errorMessage, sentAt, templateId, createdAt, createdBy, updatedAt, updatedBy }

endpoints.description: Get a notification log entry by ID. Requires PERM_NOTIF_LOG_VIEW.

features.name: Notification Lookups (NOTIFICATION module)
features.description: Read-only runtime LOV provider for NOTIF_CHANNEL / NOTIF_STATUS code lists. Any authenticated caller may read.

endpoints.description: Get notification-related lookup values (channel type / notification status) by key.

known_limitations.issue: The dispatch endpoint's documented plan specifies HTTP 202 Accepted for a successful dispatch, but the shared response-envelope helper (OperationCode.craftResponse) only expresses 200/201 from the service Status taxonomy, so a successful dispatch actually returns 200. This is a self-documented api_doc_gap in the code.
known_limitations.impact: Tests asserting a literal 202 status code on successful dispatch will fail against the real implementation; TestSprite should assert 200 for success.

known_limitations.issue: FileController's download endpoint authenticates purely via a short-lived opaque access token passed as a query parameter (?token=...), not the standard Authorization bearer JWT used everywhere else, and is on no explicit SecurityConfig public allow-list entry, meaning its authorization model differs from the rest of the API surface.
known_limitations.impact: Tests must first call POST /api/v1/files/{id}/access-token to obtain a valid token before testing download; a bearer JWT alone will not authorize this endpoint. Tokens in URLs can also leak via server logs/proxies — worth a dedicated security test for token replay/expiry.

known_limitations.issue: FileController.archiveOrDelete uses a single @PreAuthorize SpEL expression that branches on the `action` request parameter ("ARCHIVE" vs "DELETE") to select between PERM_FILE_BROWSER_UPDATE and a stricter delete authority, rather than being two separate endpoints/methods.
known_limitations.location: src/main/java/com/erp/file/service/FileService.java (around the conditional @PreAuthorize on the soft-delete method)
known_limitations.impact: TestSprite should test both action=ARCHIVE and action=DELETE against callers holding only the UPDATE authority (expect 200 for ARCHIVE, 403 for DELETE) to verify the branch isn't accidentally permissive; also test an invalid/unknown action value for expected 400 behavior.

known_limitations.issue: UserController and PermissionController deliberately use GET with @ModelAttribute query-parameter binding for search/list instead of the platform's otherwise-universal POST /search body contract used by every other module (Role, Module, Page, Configuration, File Category, MDM, Notification Channel/Template/Log).
known_limitations.impact: TestSprite must generate GET-with-query-params tests for these two resources specifically rather than assuming the POST /search shape used elsewhere; a generic test template applied uniformly across modules would misfire here.

known_limitations.issue: Role/User "assignment" mutation endpoints (assign module, assign permission, assign role, revoke variants) return HTTP 200 with a status envelope rather than 201 (create) or 204 (delete), even though revoke is semantically a deletion.
known_limitations.impact: Tests should assert 200 (not 204) on revoke endpoints and treat business-rule failures (e.g. duplicate grant, grant not found) as a 200 envelope carrying an error status code rather than a raw 409/404 in some cases — verify actual behavior since the doc comments indicate ERR-0013/ERR-0014 business statuses are conveyed inside a 200 envelope for grant-duplicate cases specifically, while not-found on revoke likely surfaces as 404.

known_limitations.issue: Several endpoints are intentionally authenticated-only with no specific @PreAuthorize authority check beyond isAuthenticated() — DashboardService (/me/modules), LookupService (/security/lookups), FileLookupService, MdmLookupValueService's active-values-by-type-code path, NotificationLookupService, and DispatchService — meaning any valid JWT holder (regardless of role/permissions) can call them.
known_limitations.impact: This is documented as deliberate in the code, but TestSprite should specifically verify these endpoints reject unauthenticated (no token) requests with 401 while accepting ANY authenticated user regardless of role — a broad security-relevant behavior worth explicit positive/negative test coverage rather than assuming permission-based 403s apply.

known_limitations.issue: The public (unauthenticated) allow-list in SecurityConfig is an exact/prefix path match list; only /api/v1/security/auth/{login,refresh,forgot-password,reset-password,activate} plus swagger/actuator health/info are public. Every other endpoint, including read-only lookups, requires a bearer token.
known_limitations.impact: TestSprite should treat any endpoint not in this exact list as requiring an Authorization: Bearer <token> header and expect 401 (via RestAuthenticationEntryPoint) when it's missing/invalid — including GET lookup endpoints that might otherwise be assumed public.

known_limitations.issue: Forgot-password intentionally returns a neutral 202 regardless of whether the email exists (anti-enumeration), so tests cannot distinguish "email exists" from "email doesn't exist" via status code alone.
known_limitations.impact: Do not write a test asserting a 404 for an unknown email on this endpoint — that would fail against the intended anti-enumeration design; assert 202 in both cases instead.
